post.description:
Sandbox research (prototype): the switch, its tick and its two spending limits. The switch can be turned on
only on a computer marked as Isogeny's own sandbox, in isolated mode, with Otto installed.
Phase 6a: the name a person types once; their decisions on proposals are recorded under it from then on.

Phase 6: Look for new advisories. One read of the public source about this assessment's libraries (package
names only are sent). It runs nothing and proposes nothing.
Phase 6: Design and prove tests, for the new advisories of the newest look, in the background.
Accept, reject (with an optional short reason), undo or reconsider one of Otto's proposals. It runs nothing.

post.description: The same answer, and the exchange kept with the assessment. It decides and starts nothing.

post.description:
Bring in a demo change (Demo data): one branch with one commit, written into this assessment's own copy of
the repository. It runs nothing. `name` is one of our own names for a bundled change, and nothing else.
Run the picked tests (then: Run again). Sent by that button, or by its Confirm in the Otto panel.

get.description: Published weaknesses in this assessment's libraries with no fix yet. It only reads: nothing is sent or written.

post.description: Look now: one click, after the box that says what is sent (package names, nothing else).
Stop watching one weakness, with an optional short reason. Recorded; nothing is deleted.
